profile.headline: Full Stack Software Engineer
profile.summary: Full Stack Web Developer with over 5 years experience based in Southern California. Passionate about the problem solving aspect of programming as well as working cooperatively with team members to build immersive applications and technologies. Responsive to feedback and always seeking to improve both personally and professionally.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Converted Figma wireframes into engaging and modern websites/applications using technologies like HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React.js,  Java, and Node.js along with utilizing Liferay's own APIs and systems. 

-Collaborated with various teams and departments to unify different ideas on software and architecture. Learned to ask questions and contribute to conversations to provide new ideas which helped me advance my technical knowledge and communication skills.

-Well versed in converting complex code into simple and readable documentation. 

-Pair programmed with other developers to quickly debug code and deliver high quality, well-tested products.

-Participated in code reviews that elevated my ability to write clean, scalable, and performant code, as well as gain strong technical communication skills.

-Engaged in all aspects of release cycles, including requirements review, work estimation, design, implementation, testing, and review
positions.insights: Skills: Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · React.js · Java · JavaScript · HTML · Python (Programming Language) · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · GitHub · SASS · Git

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
-Personally oversaw the learning of 12-15 students at a time. Ensured they mastered web development topics and technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, nodeJS, Redux, Relational Databases and much more as required by the school curriculum. Consistently received praise for breaking down complex topics and earned an 100% approval rating by the students.

-Organized and hosted daily standups and presentations to ensure students had an outlet to communicate and get help on various topics which led to my classes having a 75% or more  passing rate each quarter.
positions.insights: Skills: Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Node.js · SQL · React.js · REST APIs · AJAX · Data Structures · JavaScript · HTML · Python (Programming Language) · Django REST Framework · Knex.js · MySQL · Algorithms · Redux.js

positions.title: CS Supplemental Instructor
positions.description: Responsible for scheduling 3-5 meetings a week and reserving required rooms and materials.Applied strong communication skills to ensure supplemental lectures were understood by every student, consistently received positive feedback from students on ability to break down difficult-to-understand concepts.

positions.title: Warehouse Team Member
positions.description:
-Led a team of people to ensure my assigned section received and shipped out corresponding packages.
-Worked with Amazon database to fix problems with packages and ensure all items were accounted for.
-Oversaw training of new associates
